newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Fabric files for 3.4 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Fabric files for 3.4 mln shr offer.

text.p: Quaker Fabric Corp said on Thursday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a 3.4 million share offering.

Quaker said it planned to sell 300,000 shares, MLGA Fund II LP, an investment fund affiliated with investment banking firm Morgan Lewis Githens & Ahn, Inc would sell three million shares and Nortex Holdings Inc would sell 100,000 shares.
The company said it intended to use estimated proceeds of $4.4 million to buy production equipment in order to expand the company's chenille yarn manufacturing capacity.
